we developed two new BAC and a new BIBAC vectors for BAC/BIBA library construction and large genomic DNA insert transfer.

we have constructed a new BAC vector that can be used in the construction of large-insert BAC libraries and a new BIBAC that is suitable for both the construction and screening of large-insert BIBAC libraries.

The main takeaway from our work is that

it is easy to exchange intact large genomic DNA fragments between the BAC vector pBAC-S and the BIBAC vector pBIBAC-S, thus allowing the transfer of complete BAC inserts into the BIBAC vectors and vice versa, without the need to perform tedious and labor-intensive cloning procedures.
the two new vectors can greatly simplify BAC and BAC libraries, thus facilitating positional cloning of large genomic DNA inserts in the BAC libraries.

a pair of vectors with different antibiotic selection markers and the same non-complementing 3' protruded ATAA ends can be used as a platform for the construction and exchange of large genomic DNA inserts.
